newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open little changed.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open mostly flat on Wednesday, based on market orders at 1018 EDT, trading sources said.

Prices soared to 13-week highs on Tuesday amid speculative short covering and buying by commission houses. The most-active December contract ended up 1.65 cents at 75.93 cents per lb, traded 77.00 to 75.40 cents. The rest of the board finished 1.36 to 1.10 cents firmer.
Volume was estimated at a brisk 30,000 lots.
While the market could climb higher, the trade is expected to provide firm resistance at each tick up, traders said.
